note: HPOP shipped WASM against Tudat: largest 3D position difference over 24 h at hourly samples in each exported case frame; suite/steps30/finest HPOP settings and Orekit-minus-Tudat; 6x6 STM and Cd/Cr, Cd*A/m-rate, and in-track-acceleration sensitivity comparisons where available. Numerical reductions are C++.

tool.name: Tudat C++ library compiled to WebAssembly
tool.execution: Committed C++ driver trajectory; the package Embind API cannot configure/run propagation (duplicate registrations, station-file initialization, missing STL/Eigen bindings). No Tudat rebuild or rerun was performed.

settings.source: Tudat 1.0.0.dev4 as built by repos/ancillary-packages/tudat-wasm (Emscripten 3.1.51, its vendored Tudat sources), driven by tudat_wasm_driver.cpp under Node; same setup as tudatpy-reference.json (RKDP 8(7) fixed steps, 10 s or 1 s with radiation pressure, TT clock, Lagrange-8 to the samples, GCRS about the Earth, IERS 2010 Earth orientation with the rows of ../orekit/eop-2026-08.json, DE440 tabulated in GCRS, NRLMSISE-00 constant space weather)
settings.convergence: Historical 27-case fixture; the existing cross-validation document records step-halving evidence. This task scores committed samples without rebuilding Tudat WASM.

coverage.note: The task context calls this a 28-case subset, but the committed Tudat WASM fixture contains 27 cases. Only those stored trajectories are scored; no missing trajectory is inferred.

units.stm: maximum relative column difference; position and velocity rows compared separately
units.parameterColumns: per unit Cr*A/m, Cd*A/m, Cd*A/m rate, or in-track acceleration, as named in the shared export

protocol.frameRule: Geocentric GCRF, or EME2000 for cases explicitly exported in EME2000; compared states use the same axes.
protocol.rotationClock: Historical fixture passes TT into Tudat rotation lookup interpreted as TDB, as documented in cross-validation.md.
protocol.metric: Maximum 3D position separation over the 24 propagated hourly samples; the common initial state is stored but excluded from reduction.
protocol.toleranceRationale: The unchanged shared protocol requires 1 mm point-mass numerical agreement, 5 cm gravity-field/rotation agreement, and 0.1 m SRP/drag agreement. These are separate prescribed precision classes; a measured discrepancy never changes its limit. The GMAT-only 1.5 m drag allowance does not apply to Tudat.
protocol.convergenceRationale: A 2x finer native run must change every reported trajectory by less than 0.3 mm, below the strictest 1 mm physical comparison limit.
protocol.replayRationale: Identical stored state bytes and the same C++ reducer must reproduce the summary exactly; the one propagated replay also uses identical shipped HPOP WASM and request settings.
protocol.stmToleranceRationale: The shared protocol defines the relative-column metric without an STM pass threshold; report the measurements and known partial-model limitations.

tool.statement: Counts apply to the HPOP suite request and unchanged shared protocol tolerances. Each missed limit requires a measured cause; smaller HPOP steps are reported separately.

integration.statement: Native convergence is the measured 3D position change when Tudat fixed steps are halved; the committed WASM subset retains its historical convergence provenance.

stm.statement: STM and Cd*A/m, Cr*A/m, Cd*A/m-rate, and in-track-acceleration sensitivity agreement is reported as maximum relative column difference, separately for position and velocity rows. Native aerodynamic state partials use central finite differences at 10 m position and 0.01 m/s velocity perturbations, also used by the time-varying-drag adapter. The native cannonball SRP partial omits the eclipse-attenuation position gradient; its effect is conditional on encountering eclipse transitions, not every SRP case. R2 STM omissions record unavailable native non-Schwarzschild partials. Every exported sensitivity is included where its variational case is supported; the shared export defines no STM pass/fail threshold.
